# Multilingual fidelity

Content from every major writing system must survive conversion unchanged.

## Latin, Cyrillic and Greek

English stays Latin, Русский stays Cyrillic, and Ελληνικά stays Greek.

## Right-to-left

مرحبا بالعالم

שלום עולם

## Indic and Southeast Asian

বাংলা ভাষা, हिन्दी भाषा, தமிழ் மொழி, ไทย, မြန်မာ, ខ្មែរ

## East Asian

中文, 日本語, 한국어

## Structure

1. First language
2. দ্বিতীয় ভাষা
   - 三番目

| Language | Greeting |
